newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Boehler powers to fresh year high.
newsitem.headline: Boehler powers to fresh year high.

text.p: Shares in Austrian high-grade steelmaker Boehler-Uddeholm AG powered to a new high for the year in mid-morning trade on continued follow-through investor demand from last week.
Traders attributed the gains to selective buying driven more by technical factors than fundamentals.
At 0935 GMT, Boehler was the top gainer in an overall steady market, standing 2.04 percent or 18 schillings higher at 900. On Friday, the steelmaker was again the top gainer, adding on 3.5 percent.
Boehler earlier jumped to 915 schillings, surpassing Friday's year high of 890 schillings.
Turnover was brisk at over 43,000 lots so far this morning. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
